graph.description: Deployment readiness assessments, production deployment engineering, and fractional Robotics DevOps leadership for robotics teams in the EU and US. Repeatable releases, recoverable updates, and fleet operations the customer’s team can own. Scope, deliverables, timing, and fees are agreed before work begins.

mainEntity.name: How do we agree scope and fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: We agree the outcome, scope, access, responsibilities, timing, and fees before starting. If the work is already clear, we can scope implementation directly.

mainEntity.name: Can our team take the work forward?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. An assessment gives your engineers a reviewed roadmap they can implement themselves. Engineering engagements include documentation and handover; we agree any ongoing support separately.

mainEntity.name: How does this relate to Robotair?

acceptedAnswer.text: I founded Robotair. These engagements are with me directly. For a Robotair-specific inquiry, mention the product so we can clarify the scope.
